sentences.text: You can return an unused purchase within 30 days of delivery.
The item must be unused, but its packaging may have been opened.
Return shipping is free only when the item arrived damaged.
For all other returns, the customer pays the return shipping cost.
Start a return by emailing support with your order number.
Keep your shipping receipt until the returned package reaches our warehouse.
A refund starts after our warehouse receives and checks the returned item.
The money reaches your original payment method within five business days after that check.
We send a confirmation email when the refund is issued.
An exchange sends a replacement item instead of returning money.
Gift purchases can be refunded to the original buyer only.
Our support team can look up a refund using the order number.
Standard delivery takes three to five business days.
Express delivery takes one to two business days.
Orders above 50 dollars qualify for free standard delivery.
Delivery estimates begin when the package leaves our warehouse.
A tracking link is emailed when your order ships.
Contact support if tracking says delivered but the package is missing.
The warranty covers manufacturing defects for one year after purchase.
Accidental damage and ordinary wear are not covered by the warranty.
Email support a photo and the order number to request a warranty assessment.
A warranty assessment determines whether a repair or replacement is available.
A warranty claim is different from returning an unused item.
Warranty requests do not change the shop's 30-day return window.

queries.label: A direct question
queries.text: How many days do I have to return an unused purchase?

claims.text: You can return an unused purchase within 30 days of delivery.

queries.label: Different words, same idea
queries.text: I unboxed my purchase but never used it. Can I send it back?

claims.text: Yes. Opened packaging is allowed if the item is unused, and the return must be within 30 days of delivery.

queries.label: A rule across a chunk boundary
queries.text: Who pays return shipping if my item arrived damaged, and who pays for other returns?

claims.text: Return shipping is free for an item that arrived damaged; for other returns, the customer pays.

queries.label: Two documents are needed
queries.text: What is the return deadline, and how long does a refund take after the warehouse checks the item?

claims.text: An unused purchase can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
After the warehouse receives and checks the return, the money reaches the original payment method within five business days.
